title: The Steps I Didn't Take
narration: My fitness watch recorded 3,842 steps while I was asleep. Its route ended in the abandoned house next door, where I found photographs of sleeping strangers and tomorrow's date behind my neighbour's picture. Police found only my fingerprints and my watch charger. That evening, my neighbour vanished. I locked myself inside, but the watch congratulated me for completing another walk. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. Then a woman screamed beneath my bedroom floor, and the step counter increased by one.
